dedupe_keys.name: netherlands network operator areas for electricity gas media sewerage heat and water stichting mijn aansluiting

description: This data set gives the areas in which each network operator in the Netherlands is active, for electricity, gas, media (telecommunications), sewerage, heat and water. Stichting Mijn Aansluiting stores and manages the area information used by the Mijnaansluiting.nl connection request service, where it determines which operators are active at a given address or public space location when someone applies for a new connection, and offers it as open data through OGC WMS and WFS services. The data.overheid.nl entry, harvested from the National Georegister, shows the data set as available, public domain and last updated on 14 August 2026. Derived subsets exist, such as the heat network operator areas published by the Province of South Holland (operators Eneco Warmte, HVC and Vattenfall Warmte). Coverage is the Netherlands. Access is free through the web services. Caveats: areas show responsibility for connections, not network assets or capacity, and older data.overheid.nl links to this data set no longer resolve. Simulation uses are assigning locations to the responsible grid, gas and heat operators for interdependency mapping and emergency coordination. Related records: data-enexis-open-data-netherlands is data from one of these operators.
